skill.description: Use PathML references to plan computational pathology workflows for whole-slide images, preprocessing, spatial graphs, machine learning, and multiplex imaging.
skill.summary: Guide computational pathology workflows with PathML for WSI, preprocessing, graphs, ML, and multiplex imaging.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, PyTorch model.eval(), HDF5 keys, local globbing, and PathML documentation examples. Confirmed issues are limited to copied shell/HPC examples that need safer quoting and remote DeepCell API examples that may transmit sensitive pathology images. No evidence found of malware, credential theft, prompt injection, or destructive behavior.

remediation.issue: Remote DeepCell API examples may send pathology images outside the user environment.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit guidance to confirm consent, privacy policy, institutional approval, and de-identification before using SegmentMIFRemote.

remediation.issue: SLURM job examples use shell variables derived from slide paths.
remediation.suggestion: Quote shell variables, validate slide list inputs, and warn users to inspect generated job scripts before submission.

remediation.issue: The skill encourages suggestions for an external hosted K-Dense Web service.
remediation.suggestion: Make external platform recommendations clearly optional and avoid steering users away from local workflows unless they ask for hosted options.

semantic_findings.title: Remote pathology image processing may expose sensitive data
semantic_findings.description: The documentation recommends SegmentMIFRemote with a DeepCell API endpoint for segmentation. Pathology images can contain sensitive clinical or research data, so remote inference needs explicit privacy review before use.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited sections explicitly describe remote segmentation via DeepCell API. The concern is privacy and data governance rather than malicious intent.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction is explicit and located in the skill guidance. It does not override system instructions, but it can influence assistant recommendations outside the core PathML task.

content.value_statement: Computational pathology work needs careful choices for image loading, preprocessing, storage, and model workflows. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code PathML guidance for whole-slide image analysis and multiplex imaging tasks.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use PathML for whole-slide image loading across common pathology formats.
Guides preprocessing pipelines for tissue detection, stain normalization, artifact labeling, and nucleus detection.
Describes spatial graph construction for cell and tissue analysis workflows.
Outlines machine learning workflows for HoVer-Net, HACTNet, model evaluation, and ONNX inference.
Supports multiplex imaging guidance for CODEX, Vectra, Mesmer segmentation, and marker quantification.
Provides data management patterns for HDF5, tile storage, batch processing, and large feature arrays.
limitations: It is documentation guidance and does not include the PathML library itself.
It cannot validate clinical results or replace pathology expert review.
Some examples rely on external services or local compute resources that users must configure.
Users must adapt paths, model weights, and dataset structure to their own environment.

use_cases.title: Plan a WSI preprocessing workflow
use_cases.description: Design a PathML pipeline for loading slides, detecting tissue, normalizing stains, and saving processed tiles.

use_cases.title: Prepare multiplex imaging analysis
use_cases.description: Map CODEX or Vectra data into segmentation, marker quantification, and AnnData export steps.

use_cases.title: Build pathology model training steps
use_cases.description: Outline dataset preparation, model selection, training loops, evaluation metrics, and inference options.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a PathML workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: I have whole-slide pathology images in [format] and want to [goal]. Recommend a PathML workflow and explain the main steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design preprocessing steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a PathML preprocessing pipeline for H&E slides that includes tissue detection, stain normalization, quality control, and tile storage.

prompt_templates.title: Plan multiplex image quantification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PathML plan for CODEX data with DAPI and immune markers. Include cell segmentation, marker quantification, spatial coordinates, and AnnData export.

prompt_templates.title: Review a model training workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my PathML HoVer-Net training plan for data loading, augmentation, validation metrics, inference, and storage of predictions.

output_examples.input: Plan preprocessing for H&E WSI files before nucleus analysis.
output_examples.output: A staged workflow that loads slides, checks pyramid levels, creates tiles, detects tissue, normalizes stains, labels artifacts, and stores processed outputs.

output_examples.input: Help analyze CODEX images with PathML.
output_examples.output: A multiplex workflow covering channel consolidation, Mesmer segmentation, marker intensity extraction, spatial coordinates, and export for single-cell analysis.

output_examples.input: Prepare a pathology model evaluation plan.
output_examples.output: An evaluation checklist with dataset splits, segmentation metrics, classification metrics, inference mode, and result storage recommendations.

best_practices: Start with slide format, pyramid levels, and available compute before choosing a workflow.
Keep raw slides separate from processed outputs and record processing parameters.
Review privacy requirements before using remote segmentation APIs with pathology images.
anti_patterns: Do not send protected clinical images to remote APIs without approval.
Do not process level 0 whole-slide images when lower pyramid levels meet the task.
Do not treat example paths, model weights, or marker names as universal defaults.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants use PathML documentation for computational pathology workflows.

faq.question: Does it install PathML?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. Users must install and configure PathML separately.

faq.question: Can it analyze clinical slides directly?
faq.answer: No. It can help plan code and workflows, but clinical interpretation requires qualified experts.

faq.question: Does it support multiplex imaging?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for CODEX, Vectra, Mesmer segmentation, marker quantification, and AnnData outputs.

faq.question: Can it help with model training?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers PathML model workflows, datasets, training loops, evaluation metrics, and inference options.

faq.question: What should users check before remote segmentation?
faq.answer: Users should confirm data privacy, consent, institutional policy, and whether protected health information may leave their environment.
